thread:
emma_support: Heads-up — enterprise account `acct_83X9` reporting that free-trial credits didn't decrement after a successful text generation. Customer says UI shows same trial balance before and after call.

alex_customer: repro steps I gave them: 1) POST /v1/generate with model:open-3-small 2) 200 OK + full output returned 3) response.metadata.usage.tokens_total: 312 4) balance still reads 1000 trial credits in dashboard.

emma_support: Attached the curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test...'
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: retry-20260310-01'
  -d '{"model":"open-3-small","input":"summarize..."}'
```

emma_support: They noted they retried once because the client timed out at ~2.1s, but the server responded 200. They used same idempotency key for retry.

devon_eng: @emma_support can you paste the response headers (x-request-id, x-server-ts) from the 200 reply? Also did they see tokens returned in the response body or only in the console?

alex_customer: Response body shows usage.tokens_total: 312 in JSON. Header `X-Request-Id: req_0b4f9a2c` and `X-Server-Ts: 2026-03-10T18:12:45Z`.

liam_billing: I'll run a ledger query for acct_83X9 across that window. Can you confirm the approximate client timestamp?

alex_customer: Calls happened between 2026-03-10T18:12:42Z and 18:12:46Z. One successful 200, one client timeout but received 200 later.

billing-bot: NOTICE: querying ledger for acct_83X9 2026-03-10T18:12:00Z..2026-03-10T18:15:00Z

billing-bot: RESULT: No debit entries found for usage tokens in that window. Balance stays at 1000 trial units.

liam_billing: Interesting — response shows tokens but ledger has no debit. Possible causes: (a) async billing job failed to enqueue, (b) idempotency logic deduped and skipped billing when retry metadata flagged as duplicate, (c) a race in the post-commit hook. @devon_eng can you check event router logs for req_0b4f9a2c and the idempotency key `retry-20260310-01`?

devon_eng: On it. Quick note: we recently patched a change where we only emit usage events after the response is acked by the write-service. If client observed 200 but the ack wasn't recorded due to a transient DB write error, usage might not have been emitted.

devon_eng: Pulling logs now — matching request found. Server produced model output and returned 200. I see an error in the downstream write queue at 18:12:46: `Err: kafka: partition not available` followed by a retry that succeeded for other requests but not this idempotency key. There is no usage_event for req_0b4f9a2c.

liam_billing: That explains missing ledger entry. But we need to know whether the customer was billed later (outside window) or never. I will expand the query to +24h.

billing-bot: EXPANDED QUERY: 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z..2026-03-11T00:00:00Z — no debit for tokens for acct_83X9 tied to req_0b4f9a2c or idempotency key.

ingrid_pm: High-level ask from product: we need a short incident note for the customer, root cause hypothesis, and an onboarding fix. If this is a transient write queue gap we likely should credit them immediately and patch the emitter to retry more aggressively.

liam_billing: Proposed remediation: 1) Issue a manual debit of 312 tokens to align ledger with observed usage OR issue a credit adjustment if we decide to waive. 2) Notify customer with root-cause ETA. 3) Engineering to add stronger retry and alerting on missing usage_event emit.

emma_support: Customer requests they don't want a charge if they already lost time. They're asking for a credit back if we decide we did consume their quota. Can we propose an immediate one-time 312 token credit while we fix the pipeline?

devon_eng: I can deploy a patch that adds guaranteed local journal + exponential retry to the emitter, and an alert when usage_event hasn't been observed within 30s for a returned-200 request. Timeline: patch + canary in ~4 hours, full rollout ~12 hours.

liam_billing: I'll provisionally credit 312 tokens to acct_83X9 and flag for reversal if it turns out ledger later shows a true debit. We'll include a note linking to req_0b4f9a2c.

emma_support: OK I'll tell the customer we've credited 312 trial tokens, opened an engineering ticket (INF-2379) for the emitter guarantee, and we'll follow up when the fix rolls out.

alex_customer: Thanks, appreciate the quick help. Please send confirmation when deploy is live.

devon_eng: INF-2379 created. Assigning to me + eng-runtime. I'll update this thread with canary results. :white_check_mark:
